customManagers.description: Node major in the Dockerfile (node:24, node:24-alpine) and the InSpec Dockerfile control. node versioning cannot read -alpine tags, so these are read from Node's own releases instead of Docker Hub.
Node major asserted by the container structure test (test name and expected node --version output).

packageRules.description: npm keeps package.json ranges current (as Dependabot did); other managers keep their default, so Gemfile constraints are not rewritten.
npm runtime minor and patch, including the express-scoped qs override: one low-risk PR, auto-merged once the required checks pass.
npm tooling minor and patch: kept apart from runtime so a tooling break never holds back a runtime fix.
Majors wait 30 days so upstream peers can catch up (jest-pact 0.14 shipped after pact 17).
Lint and Babel majors only work together (ESLint needs a matching @babel/eslint-parser and @babel/core).

Pact and jest-pact always move together, whatever the update type, in one branch (separateMajorMinor off): a pact major needs the matching jest-pact (pact 17 needs jest-pact 0.14), so splitting them left the pact PR unresolvable on its own. After the jest and npm development rules so jest-pact lands here. Minor/patch-only pact PRs auto-merge (from the npm development rule); one carrying a major does not (catch-all rule below).
GitHub Actions minor and patch together; each action's major arrives on its own.
faraday stays on 1.x: inspec ~> 7.0 requires faraday_middleware, which requires faraday ~> 1.0, so faraday 2 cannot resolve (PR #835). Revisit if InSpec drops faraday_middleware.
Bundler (InSpec test tooling) minor and patch together.
Other container images (compose) minor, patch and digest together, auto-merged.

Every update auto-merges by default (top-level automerge) except majors, whatever group they land in. Majors can pass CI and still break what CI does not cover (#833's @sonar/scan 5 broke the local pre-push hook). GitHub Actions are the exception (next rule).

GitHub Actions auto-merge at any version, majors included, once the required checks pass. Caveat: actions in jobs skipped for renovate[bot] (docker/login-action, snyk, trivy, anchore, attest, ...) or only in deploy.yml and release.yml do not run on the PR, so a major of one of those merges untested.
The Docker Hub node images are handled by the node-version custom manager instead, so Node majors stay LTS-only and move with every other pin.

Node: LTS releases only (node versioning treats a new major as stable once it reaches LTS). One PR moves .nvmrc, package.json engines, the Dockerfile, the structure test and the InSpec control together. CI reads .nvmrc via setup-node. Never auto-merged.
